````python
"""Vendor-neutral RED metrics with strict low-cardinality labels and OTLP export."""
from __future__ import annotations
import logging
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any
from opentelemetry import metrics
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.observability.policy import sanitize_metric_labels
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_lock = Lock()
_provider: Any | None = None
_request_counter: Any | None = None
_request_duration: Any | None = None
_auth_failure_counter: Any | None = None
_rate_limit_counter: Any | None = None
_pipeline_events: Any | None = None
_screening_duration: Any | None = None
_queue_wait_duration: Any | None = None
_end_to_end_duration: Any | None = None
_outbox_dispatch_lag: Any | None = None
_outbox_dead_gauge: Any | None = None
_outbox_pending_gauge: Any | None = None
_redis_queue_gauge: Any | None = None
_dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge: Any | None = None
_audit_chain_valid_gauge: Any | None = None
_db_pool_in_use_gauge: Any | None = None
_db_pool_available_gauge: Any | None = None
_audit_head_lock_duration: Any | None = None
_ALLOWED_AUTH_REASONS = frozenset(
    {"missing", "invalid", "forbidden", "jwks_unavailable"}
)
_ALLOWED_RATE_DECISIONS = frozenset(
    {"allowed", "limited", "backend_error_closed", "backend_error_open"}
)
_PIPELINE_EVENT_TYPES = frozenset(
    {
        "outbox.claimed",
        "outbox.dispatched",
        "outbox.failed",
        "outbox.dead",
        "celery.task.started",
        "celery.task.completed",
        "celery.task.retry",
        "celery.task.failed",
        "screening.duplicate",
        "screening.reclaimed",
        "screening.completed",
        "screening.failed",
        "pipeline.other",
    }
)
_PIPELINE_OUTCOMES = frozenset(
    {"success", "failure", "retry", "dead", "duplicate", "reclaimed", "unknown"}
)
_PIPELINE_STAGES = frozenset(
    {"outbox", "celery", "claim", "redact", "graph", "persist", "unknown"}
)
def _signal_endpoint(settings: Settings, signal: str) -> str:
    endpoint = settings.otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint.rstrip("/")
    if endpoint.endswith(f"/v1/{signal}"):
        return endpoint
    if endpoint.endswith("/v1"):
        return f"{endpoint}/{signal}"
    return f"{endpoint}/v1/{signal}"
def initialize_metrics(settings: Settings) -> None:
    """Create an asynchronous OTLP metric reader once per process when telemetry is enabled."""
    global \
        _provider, \
        _request_counter, \
        _request_duration, \
        _auth_failure_counter, \
        _rate_limit_counter
    global _pipeline_events, _screening_duration, _queue_wait_duration
    global _end_to_end_duration, _outbox_dispatch_lag
    global \
        _outbox_dead_gauge, \
        _outbox_pending_gauge, \
        _redis_queue_gauge, \
        _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge, \
        _audit_chain_valid_gauge
    global _db_pool_available_gauge, _db_pool_in_use_gauge, _audit_head_lock_duration
    if not settings.otel_enabled:
        return
    with _lock:
        if _provider is not None:
            return
        from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.metric_exporter import (
            OTLPMetricExporter,
        )
        from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider
        from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics.export import PeriodicExportingMetricReader
        from opentelemetry.sdk.resources import Resource
        resource = Resource.create(
            {
                "service.name": settings.service_name,
                "service.version": settings.service_version or "unknown",
                "deployment.environment.name": settings.environment,
            }
        )
        exporter = OTLPMetricExporter(
            endpoint=_signal_endpoint(settings, "metrics"), timeout=5
        )
        reader = PeriodicExportingMetricReader(
            exporter, export_interval_millis=5000, export_timeout_millis=5000
        )
        provider = MeterProvider(resource=resource, metric_readers=[reader])
        metrics.set_meter_provider(provider)
        meter = metrics.get_meter("app.observability", "1.0.0")
        _request_counter = meter.create_counter(
            "app.http.server.request.count",
            unit="{request}",
            description="Completed HTTP requests",
        )
        _request_duration = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.http.server.request.duration",
            unit="s",
            description="HTTP request duration",
        )
        _auth_failure_counter = meter.create_counter(
            "auth.failures",
            unit="{failure}",
            description="Authentication and authorization failures",
        )
        _rate_limit_counter = meter.create_counter(
            "screening.rate_limit.decisions",
            unit="{decision}",
            description="Screening rate-limit decisions",
        )
        _pipeline_events = meter.create_counter(
            "app.pipeline.events",
            unit="{event}",
            description="Outbox and screening worker lifecycle events",
        )
        _screening_duration = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.screening.processing.duration",
            unit="s",
            description="Screening task execution time",
        )
        _queue_wait_duration = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.pipeline.queue.wait",
            unit="s",
            description="Time from outbox enqueue to worker start",
        )
        _end_to_end_duration = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.screening.end_to_end.duration",
            unit="s",
            description="Time from screening enqueue to processing completion",
        )
        _outbox_dispatch_lag = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.outbox.dispatch.lag",
            unit="s",
            description="Time from outbox enqueue to broker dispatch",
        )
        _outbox_dead_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.outbox.dead",
            unit="{event}",
            description="Current dead-letter outbox count",
        )
        _outbox_pending_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.outbox.pending",
            unit="{event}",
            description="Current pending outbox count",
        )
        _redis_queue_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.pipeline.redis_queue_length",
            unit="{message}",
            description="Celery Redis queue length",
        )
        _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.pipeline.dispatcher_heartbeat",
            unit="{status}",
            description="Dispatcher heartbeat status (1=alive, 0=dead)",
        )
        _audit_chain_valid_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.audit.chain_valid",
            unit="{status}",
            description="Audit chain integrity status (1=valid, 0=invalid)",
        )
        _db_pool_in_use_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.db.pool.in_use",
            unit="{connection}",
            description="Database pool connections currently checked out",
        )
        _db_pool_available_gauge = meter.create_gauge(
            "app.db.pool.available",
            unit="{connection}",
            description="Database pool available connections",
        )
        _audit_head_lock_duration = meter.create_histogram(
            "app.audit.head_lock.duration",
            unit="s",
            description="Audit head lock acquisition time",
        )
        _provider = provider
def _safe_add(instrument: Any | None, value: int, attributes: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    if instrument is None:
        return
    try:
        instrument.add(value, attributes)
    except Exception as exc:  # telemetry must not affect application behavior
        logger.debug("metric update failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
def record_http_request(
    *, route: str, method: str, status_code: int, duration_seconds: float
) -> None:
    if _request_counter is None:
        return
    status_class = f"{max(0, min(5, int(status_code) // 100))}xx"
    attributes = sanitize_metric_labels(
        {"route": route, "method": method, "status_class": status_class}
    )
    _safe_add(_request_counter, 1, attributes)
    try:
        _request_duration.record(max(0.0, float(duration_seconds)), attributes)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("metric observation failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
def record_auth_failure(reason: str) -> None:
    normalized = reason if reason in _ALLOWED_AUTH_REASONS else "invalid"
    attributes = sanitize_metric_labels({"reason": normalized})
    _safe_add(_auth_failure_counter, 1, attributes)
def record_rate_limit_decision(decision: str) -> None:
    normalized = (
        decision if decision in _ALLOWED_RATE_DECISIONS else "backend_error_closed"
    )
    attributes = sanitize_metric_labels({"decision": normalized})
    _safe_add(_rate_limit_counter, 1, attributes)
def record_pipeline_event(
    event_type: str,
    *,
    outcome: str,
    stage: str,
    error_type: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    value: int = 1,
) -> None:
    """Record a pipeline event using fixed vocabularies and low-cardinality labels only."""
    normalized_event = (
        event_type if event_type in _PIPELINE_EVENT_TYPES else "pipeline.other"
    )
    normalized_outcome = outcome if outcome in _PIPELINE_OUTCOMES else "unknown"
    normalized_stage = stage if stage in _PIPELINE_STAGES else "unknown"
    attributes = sanitize_metric_labels(
        {
            "event_type": normalized_event,
            "outcome": normalized_outcome,
            "stage": normalized_stage,
            "error_type": error_type,
            "status": status,
        }
    )
    _safe_add(_pipeline_events, max(0, int(value)), attributes)
def _record_duration(
    instrument: Any | None,
    seconds: float,
    attributes: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    if instrument is None:
        return
    try:
        value = float(seconds)
        if value < 0 or value != value or value == float("inf"):
            return
        instrument.record(value, attributes or {})
    except Exception as exc:  # telemetry must never change task behavior
        logger.debug("duration metric failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
def record_screening_duration(seconds: float, outcome: str) -> None:
    normalized = (
        outcome if outcome in {"success", "failure", "retry", "unknown"} else "unknown"
    )
    _record_duration(
        _screening_duration, seconds, sanitize_metric_labels({"outcome": normalized})
    )
def record_queue_wait(seconds: float) -> None:
    _record_duration(_queue_wait_duration, seconds)
def record_end_to_end_duration(seconds: float) -> None:
    _record_duration(_end_to_end_duration, seconds)
def record_outbox_dispatch_lag(seconds: float) -> None:
    _record_duration(_outbox_dispatch_lag, seconds)
def record_audit_head_lock_duration(seconds: float, outcome: str = "success") -> None:
    normalized = (
        outcome
        if outcome in {"success", "failure", "timeout", "unknown"}
        else "unknown"
    )
    _record_duration(
        _audit_head_lock_duration,
        seconds,
        sanitize_metric_labels({"outcome": normalized}),
    )
def record_pipeline_gauges(stats: dict[str, int | float], audit_valid: int = 1) -> None:
    global \
        _outbox_dead_gauge, \
        _outbox_pending_gauge, \
        _redis_queue_gauge, \
        _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge, \
        _audit_chain_valid_gauge
    global _db_pool_in_use_gauge, _db_pool_available_gauge
    try:
        if _outbox_dead_gauge is not None:
            _outbox_dead_gauge.set(float(stats.get("outbox_dead", 0)))
        if _outbox_pending_gauge is not None:
            _outbox_pending_gauge.set(float(stats.get("outbox_pending", 0)))
        if _redis_queue_gauge is not None:
            _redis_queue_gauge.set(float(stats.get("redis_celery_queue_length", 0)))
        if _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge is not None:
            hb = stats.get("dispatcher_heartbeat_present", 1)
            _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge.set(float(hb))
        if _audit_chain_valid_gauge is not None:
            _audit_chain_valid_gauge.set(float(audit_valid))
        if _db_pool_in_use_gauge is not None:
            _db_pool_in_use_gauge.set(float(stats.get("db_pool_in_use", 0)))
        if _db_pool_available_gauge is not None:
            _db_pool_available_gauge.set(float(stats.get("db_pool_available", 0)))
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("pipeline gauge update failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
def flush_metrics(timeout_millis: int = 5000) -> bool:
    provider = _provider
    if provider is None:
        return True
    try:
        return bool(provider.force_flush(timeout_millis=timeout_millis))
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("metric flush failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
        return False
def shutdown_metrics() -> None:
    global \
        _provider, \
        _request_counter, \
        _request_duration, \
        _auth_failure_counter, \
        _rate_limit_counter
    global _pipeline_events, _screening_duration, _queue_wait_duration
    global _end_to_end_duration, _outbox_dispatch_lag
    global \
        _outbox_dead_gauge, \
        _outbox_pending_gauge, \
        _redis_queue_gauge, \
        _dispatcher_heartbeat_gauge, \
        _audit_chain_valid_gauge
    with _lock:
        provider = _provider
        _provider = None
        _request_counter = _request_duration = None
        _auth_failure_counter = _rate_limit_counter = None
        _pipeline_events = _screening_duration = _queue_wait_duration = None
        _end_to_end_duration = _outbox_dispatch_lag = _audit_head_lock_duration = None
    if provider is not None:
        try:
            provider.shutdown(timeout_millis=5000)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("metric shutdown failed error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
````

## File: app/main.py
````python
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from app.api.v1.router import api_router
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.rate_limit import close_rate_limit_client
from app.db.session import engine
from app.observability import setup_observability
from app.observability.instrumentation import instrument_api, uninstrument_api
from app.observability.metrics import (
    flush_metrics,
    initialize_metrics,
    record_http_request,
    shutdown_metrics,
)
from app.observability.middleware import RequestTelemetryMiddleware
from app.observability.tracing import (
    flush_tracing,
    initialize_tracing,
    shutdown_tracing,
)
settings = get_settings()
setup_observability("api", settings)
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_: FastAPI):
    if settings.otel_enabled:
        initialize_tracing(settings)
        initialize_metrics(settings)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        try:
            await close_rate_limit_client()
        finally:
            try:
                await engine.dispose()
            finally:
                uninstrument_api(app, settings)
                flush_metrics()
                flush_tracing()
                shutdown_metrics()
                shutdown_tracing()
app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.app_name,
    version="1.2.0",
    description=(
        "Evidence-focused candidate-screening decision support. Outputs are advisory and require "
        "human review; the service does not make or automate hiring decisions."
    ),
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs" if settings.environment != "production" else None,
    redoc_url=None,
    openapi_url=None if settings.environment == "production" else "/openapi.json",
)
if settings.cors_origins:
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
        allow_credentials=False,
        allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
        allow_headers=[
            "Content-Type",
            "X-API-Key",
            "Authorization",
            "X-Request-ID",
            "Idempotency-Key",
        ],
        expose_headers=["X-Request-ID"],
    )
app.add_middleware(RequestTelemetryMiddleware)
@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def unhandled_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    # Avoid reflecting exception text, prompts, or applicant data in client-visible errors.
    import logging
    logging.getLogger(__name__).error(
        "unhandled request error request_id=%s exception_type=%s",
        getattr(request.state, "request_id", "unknown"),
        type(exc).__name__,
    )
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    try:
        route = request.scope.get("route")
        route_path = getattr(route, "path", "unmatched") if route else "unmatched"
        record_http_request(
            route=route_path,
            method=request.method,
            status_code=500,
            duration_seconds=0.0,
        )
    except Exception:
        pass
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=500,
        headers={
            "X-Request-ID": request_id or "unknown",
            "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
            "X-Frame-Options": "DENY",
            "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer",
        },
        content={
            "detail": "Internal server error",
            "request_id": request_id,
        },
    )
app.include_router(api_router)
instrument_api(app, engine, settings)
````

## File: migrations/env.py
````python
from logging.config import fileConfig
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import pool
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db.base import Base
config = context.config
config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", get_settings().database_url.replace("%", "%%"))
if config.config_file_name:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)
target_metadata = Base.metadata
def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=get_settings().database_url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()
async def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()
def do_run_migrations(connection) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata, compare_type=True
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()
if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    import asyncio
    asyncio.run(run_migrations_online())
````

## File: app/core/config.py
````python
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Annotated, Literal
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from pydantic import Field, SecretStr, field_validator, model_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, NoDecode, SettingsConfigDict
class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Runtime configuration. Secrets must be injected by the deployment environment."""
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8", extra="ignore"
    )
    app_name: str = "LangGraph Candidate Screening API"
    environment: Literal["development", "test", "staging", "production"] = "development"
    log_level: str = "INFO"
    # `console` keeps the historical human-readable format; `json` emits one object per line.
    log_format: Literal["console", "json"] = "console"
    service_name: str = "candidate-screening"
    service_version: str | None = None  # defaults to the installed package version
    # Keyed-hash salt for actor identifiers in telemetry. Unset means actor identity is never emitted.
    telemetry_hash_salt: SecretStr | None = None
    # LangSmith/LangChain tracing exports prompts that contain applicant data to a third party.
    # Startup fails in staging/production while it is enabled, unless this is set deliberately.
    allow_langsmith_tracing: bool = False
    # OTel is opt-in by default so local development does not require an OTLP collector.
    otel_enabled: bool = False
    otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint: str = "http://localhost:4318"
    # Unset chooses 100% in development/test and 10% in staging/production.
    otel_trace_sample_ratio: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    cors_origins: Annotated[list[str], NoDecode] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # `auto` supports OIDC bearer tokens and a constant-time API-key fallback. Prefer OIDC in prod.
    auth_mode: Literal["auto", "api_key", "oidc"] = "auto"
    api_key: SecretStr | None = None
    oidc_issuer: str | None = None
    oidc_audience: str | None = None
    oidc_jwks_url: str | None = None
    oidc_roles_claim: str = "roles"
    oidc_scopes_claim: str = "scope"
    oidc_tenant_claim: str = "tenant_id"
    oidc_require_tenant_claim: bool = True
    oidc_algorithms: Annotated[list[str], NoDecode] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["RS256"]
    )
    database_url: str = (
        "postgresql+asyncpg://screening:screening_dev_password@localhost:5432/screening"
    )
    redis_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/0"
    celery_broker_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/1"
    celery_result_backend: str = "redis://localhost:6379/2"
    openai_api_key: SecretStr | None = None
    openai_model: str = "gpt-4o-mini"
    llm_base_url: str | None = None
    llm_timeout_seconds: float = Field(default=45.0, gt=0, le=180)
    max_application_chars: int = Field(default=30000, ge=100, le=100000)
    task_max_retries: int = Field(default=2, ge=0, le=5)
    screening_rate_limit_requests: int = Field(default=30, ge=1, le=10000)
    screening_rate_limit_window_seconds: int = Field(default=60, ge=1, le=86400)
    rate_limit_fail_open: bool = False
    outbox_batch_size: int = Field(default=50, ge=1, le=500)
    outbox_max_attempts: int = Field(default=12, ge=1, le=100)
    outbox_lease_seconds: int = Field(default=120, ge=10, le=3600)
    stale_processing_seconds: int = Field(default=900, ge=60, le=86400)
    pii_redaction_enabled: bool = True
    pii_redaction_policy: Literal["baseline", "strict"] = "baseline"
    screening_rubric_version: str = "screening-rubric-v1"
    @field_validator("cors_origins", "oidc_algorithms", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def parse_csv_lists(cls, value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return [item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip()]
        return value
    @field_validator("oidc_issuer", "oidc_audience", "oidc_jwks_url", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def normalize_optional_urls(cls, value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = value.strip()
            return value or None
        return value
    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_security_configuration(self):
        if self.auth_mode == "oidc" and not all(
            (self.oidc_issuer, self.oidc_audience, self.oidc_jwks_url)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_AUDIENCE, and OIDC_JWKS_URL are required for AUTH_MODE=oidc"
            )
        if self.oidc_issuer or self.oidc_audience or self.oidc_jwks_url:
            if not all((self.oidc_issuer, self.oidc_audience, self.oidc_jwks_url)):
                raise ValueError(
                    "OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_AUDIENCE, and OIDC_JWKS_URL must be configured together"
                )
            for name in ("oidc_issuer", "oidc_jwks_url"):
                parsed = urlparse(getattr(self, name) or "")
                if parsed.scheme not in (
                    {"https"} if self.environment == "production" else {"http", "https"}
                ):
                    raise ValueError(f"{name.upper()} must use HTTPS in production")
        allowed_algorithms = {"RS256", "RS384", "RS512", "ES256", "ES384", "ES512"}
        if not self.oidc_algorithms or any(
            item not in allowed_algorithms for item in self.oidc_algorithms
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "OIDC_ALGORITHMS must contain only supported asymmetric signing algorithms"
            )
        if self.auth_mode == "api_key" and not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("API_KEY is required when AUTH_MODE=api_key")
        if self.environment == "production":
            oidc_ready = bool(
                self.oidc_issuer and self.oidc_audience and self.oidc_jwks_url
            )
            if self.auth_mode == "oidc" and not oidc_ready:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Complete OIDC configuration is required in production"
                )
            if self.auth_mode == "auto" and not (self.api_key or oidc_ready):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Configure OIDC or API_KEY for production authentication"
                )
        return self
@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    """Return a cached ``Settings`` instance loaded from the environment / `.env`."""
    return Settings()
````

## File: app/workers/pipeline_stats.py
````python
"""Periodic background stats collection for outbox backlog, queues, and worker health."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from app.core.rate_limit import get_rate_limit_redis_client
from app.db.models.outbox_event import OutboxEvent
from app.db.models.screening import Screening
from app.db.session import AsyncSessionLocal, engine
from app.observability.metrics import record_pipeline_event, record_pipeline_gauges
from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
def _run_async(coro_fn_or_coro):
    """Safely run a coroutine or callable whether an event loop is already running or not."""
    res = coro_fn_or_coro() if callable(coro_fn_or_coro) else coro_fn_or_coro
    if not asyncio.iscoroutine(res):
        return res
    try:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    except RuntimeError:
        loop = None
    if loop and loop.is_running():
        import concurrent.futures
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            return executor.submit(asyncio.run, res).result()
    else:
        return asyncio.run(res)
async def _execute_stats_query(
    session: AsyncSession, now: datetime, stats: dict[str, int | float]
) -> None:
    try:
        cutoff = now - timedelta(days=7)
        await session.execute(
            delete(OutboxEvent).where(
                OutboxEvent.status == "dispatched",
                OutboxEvent.dispatched_at < cutoff,
            )
        )
        await session.commit()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(
            "failed to prune dispatched outbox events error_type=%s",
            type(exc).__name__,
        )
    outbox_counts = dict(
        (
            await session.execute(
                select(OutboxEvent.status, func.count(OutboxEvent.id))
                .where(OutboxEvent.status.in_(["pending", "dispatching", "dead"]))
                .group_by(OutboxEvent.status)
            )
        ).all()
    )
    stats["outbox_pending"] = outbox_counts.get("pending", 0)
    stats["outbox_dispatching"] = outbox_counts.get("dispatching", 0)
    stats["outbox_dead"] = outbox_counts.get("dead", 0)
    oldest_pending = await session.scalar(
        select(func.min(OutboxEvent.created_at)).where(OutboxEvent.status == "pending")
    )
    if oldest_pending:
        stats["outbox_oldest_pending_age_seconds"] = (
            now - oldest_pending.astimezone(UTC)
        ).total_seconds()
    else:
        stats["outbox_oldest_pending_age_seconds"] = 0.0
    stale_running_count = await session.scalar(
        select(func.count(Screening.id)).where(Screening.status == "running")
    )
    stats["screenings_stale_running"] = stale_running_count or 0
async def collect_pipeline_statistics(
    session: AsyncSession | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int | float]:
    """Query non-terminal backlog states, screening ages, and Redis queue depth."""
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    stats: dict[str, int | float] = {}
    if session is not None:
        await _execute_stats_query(session, now, stats)
    else:
        async with AsyncSessionLocal() as sess:
            await _execute_stats_query(sess, now, stats)
    try:
        pool = engine.sync_engine.pool
        stats["db_pool_in_use"] = getattr(pool, "checkedout", lambda: 0)()
        stats["db_pool_available"] = getattr(pool, "checkedin", lambda: 0)()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(
            "failed to collect db pool stats error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__
        )
        stats["db_pool_in_use"] = 0
        stats["db_pool_available"] = 0
    try:
        redis_client = get_rate_limit_redis_client()
        queue_len = await redis_client.llen("celery")
        stats["redis_celery_queue_length"] = queue_len
        hb = await redis_client.get("dispatcher:heartbeat")
        stats["dispatcher_heartbeat_present"] = 1 if hb else 0
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(
            "failed to check redis queue length error_type=%s", type(exc).__name__
        )
        stats["dispatcher_heartbeat_present"] = 0
    record_pipeline_event("pipeline.stats_collected", outcome="success", stage="outbox")
    record_pipeline_gauges(stats)
    logger.info("pipeline stats collected: %s", stats)
    return stats
@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.pipeline_stats.collect_stats_task")
def collect_stats_task() -> dict[str, int | float]:
    """Celery beat task wrapper for pipeline stats collection."""
    try:
        return _run_async(collect_pipeline_statistics)
    finally:
        try:
            from app.db.session import worker_engine
            worker_engine.sync_engine.dispose()
        except Exception:
            pass
````

## File: app/services/screening_service.py
````python
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from app.audit.service import record_audit_event
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db.session import AsyncSessionLocal
from app.observability.llm_callbacks import TelemetryCallbackHandler
from app.observability.metrics import record_pipeline_event
from app.observability.pipeline import traced_stage
from app.privacy.pii_redaction import redact_pii
from app.repositories.screenings import get_screening
from app.schemas.assessment import ExperienceAssessment, SkillsAssessment
from app.workflows.screening.graph import create_screening_graph
from app.workflows.screening.prompts import PROMPT_VERSION
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
async def process_screening(
    screening_id: uuid.UUID, *, allow_reclaim_running: bool = False
) -> None:
    """Run the graph over minimized text and persist provenance plus a privacy-safe audit event."""
    settings = get_settings()
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        with traced_stage("claim", screening_id=str(screening_id)):
            screening = await get_screening(session, screening_id, for_update=True)
        if screening is None:
            logger.warning(
                "screening task references missing record id=%s", screening_id
            )
            return
        if screening.status == "completed":
            record_pipeline_event(
                "screening.duplicate", outcome="duplicate", stage="claim"
            )
            return  # Idempotent for task redelivery after a successful commit.
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        if (
            screening.status == "running"
            and screening.processing_started_at is not None
        ):
            age_seconds = (now - screening.processing_started_at).total_seconds()
            if (
                not allow_reclaim_running
                and age_seconds < settings.stale_processing_seconds
            ):
                logger.info("duplicate screening task ignored id=%s", screening_id)
                record_pipeline_event(
                    "screening.duplicate", outcome="duplicate", stage="claim"
                )
                return
            if allow_reclaim_running:
                logger.warning(
                    "reclaiming redelivered running task id=%s", screening_id
                )
                record_pipeline_event(
                    "screening.reclaimed", outcome="reclaimed", stage="claim"
                )
            else:
                logger.warning(
                    "reclaiming stale screening task id=%s age_seconds=%s",
                    screening_id,
                    int(age_seconds),
                )
        screening.status = "running"
        screening.processing_started_at = now
        screening.error_code = None
        screening.attempt_count += 1
        screening.model_version = settings.openai_model
        screening.prompt_version = PROMPT_VERSION
        raw_application_text = screening.application_text
        job_title = screening.job_title
        required_skills = screening.required_skills
        await session.commit()
    redaction_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    redacted_categories: list[str] = []
    try:
        with traced_stage("redact", screening_id=str(screening_id)):
            redaction = redact_pii(
                raw_application_text,
                enabled=settings.pii_redaction_enabled,
                policy=settings.pii_redaction_policy,
            )
        redaction_counts = redaction.counts
        redacted_categories = redaction.categories
        graph = create_screening_graph()
        with traced_stage("graph", screening_id=str(screening_id)):
            callbacks = [TelemetryCallbackHandler(model_name=settings.openai_model)]
            result = await graph.ainvoke(
                {
                    "screening_id": str(screening_id),
                    "application_text": redaction.text[
                        : settings.max_application_chars
                    ],
                    "job_title": job_title,
                    "required_skills": required_skills,
                },
                config={"callbacks": callbacks},
            )
        experience: ExperienceAssessment = result["experience_assessment"]
        skills: SkillsAssessment = result["skills_assessment"]
    except Exception as exc:
        record_pipeline_event(
            "screening.failed",
            outcome="failure",
            stage="persist",
            error_type=type(exc).__name__,
        )
        logger.error(
            "screening processing failed id=%s error_type=%s",
            screening_id,
            type(exc).__name__,
        )
        async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
            row = await get_screening(session, screening_id, for_update=True)
            if row is not None:
                row.status = "failed"
                row.processing_started_at = None
                row.error_code = "screening_processing_failed"
                row.redaction_summary = redaction_counts
                row.processed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
                await record_audit_event(
                    session,
                    principal=None,
                    tenant_id=row.tenant_id,
                    request_id=row.request_id,
                    action="screening.processing_failed",
                    resource_type="screening",
                    resource_id=str(row.id),
                    outcome="failure",
                    metadata={
                        "attempt_count": row.attempt_count,
                        "model_version": settings.openai_model,
                        "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
                        "redacted_categories": redacted_categories,
                    },
                )
                with traced_stage("persist", screening_id=str(screening_id)):
                    await session.commit()
        raise
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        row = await get_screening(session, screening_id, for_update=True)
        if row is None:
            return
        row.status = "completed"
        row.processing_started_at = None
        row.experience_level = experience.level.value
        row.experience_confidence = experience.confidence
        row.experience_evidence = experience.evidence
        row.skills_match = skills.match.value
        row.skills_confidence = skills.confidence
        row.skills_evidence = skills.evidence
        row.skill_gaps = skills.gaps
        row.recommendation = result["recommendation"].value
        row.recommendation_reason = result["recommendation_reason"]
        row.human_review_required = True
        row.model_version = settings.openai_model
        row.prompt_version = PROMPT_VERSION
        row.redaction_summary = redaction.counts
        row.error_code = None
        row.processed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        await record_audit_event(
            session,
            principal=None,
            tenant_id=row.tenant_id,
            request_id=row.request_id,
            action="screening.processing_completed",
            resource_type="screening",
            resource_id=str(row.id),
            metadata={
                "status": row.status,
                "model_version": row.model_version,
                "prompt_version": row.prompt_version,
                "redacted_categories": redaction.categories,
                "attempt_count": row.attempt_count,
            },
        )
        with traced_stage("persist", screening_id=str(screening_id)):
            await session.commit()
        record_pipeline_event("screening.completed", outcome="success", stage="persist")
````

````python
from celery import Celery
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db.session import configure_worker_db
from app.observability.policy import enforce_langsmith_policy
configure_worker_db()
settings = get_settings()
# Worker and beat both import this module; refuse to start with third-party LLM tracing enabled.
enforce_langsmith_policy(settings)
celery_app = Celery(
    "candidate_screening",
    broker=settings.celery_broker_url,
    backend=settings.celery_result_backend,
    include=["app.workers.tasks", "app.workers.outbox", "app.workers.pipeline_stats"],
)
celery_app.conf.update(
    task_serializer="json",
    result_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    task_track_started=True,
    task_acks_late=True,
    task_reject_on_worker_lost=True,
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,
    task_time_limit=180,
    task_soft_time_limit=150,
    result_expires=3600,
    timezone="UTC",
    enable_utc=True,
    beat_schedule={
        "dispatch-screening-outbox-every-10-seconds": {
            "task": "app.workers.outbox.dispatch_pending_outbox",
            "schedule": 10.0,
        },
        "collect-pipeline-stats-every-60-seconds": {
            "task": "app.workers.pipeline_stats.collect_stats_task",
            "schedule": 60.0,
        },
    },
)
````

## File: app/workers/outbox.py
````python
"""Celery outbox dispatcher: retries delivery without losing committed work."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from sqlalchemy import and_, or_, select, update
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.rate_limit import get_rate_limit_redis_client
from app.db.models.outbox_event import OutboxEvent
from app.db.session import AsyncSessionLocal
from app.observability.metrics import record_outbox_dispatch_lag, record_pipeline_event
from app.observability.pipeline import traced_stage
from app.observability.tracing import extract_trace_context
from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app
from app.workers.tasks import screen_candidate
from app.workers.telemetry import build_task_headers
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
def _run_async(coro_fn_or_coro):
    """Safely run a coroutine or callable whether an event loop is already running or not."""
    res = coro_fn_or_coro() if callable(coro_fn_or_coro) else coro_fn_or_coro
    if not asyncio.iscoroutine(res):
        return res
    try:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    except RuntimeError:
        loop = None
    if loop and loop.is_running():
        import concurrent.futures
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            return executor.submit(asyncio.run, res).result()
    else:
        return asyncio.run(res)
async def _claim_batch(limit: int) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, dict, int]]:
    settings = get_settings()
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    stale_before = now - timedelta(seconds=settings.outbox_lease_seconds)
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        expired_result = await session.execute(
            update(OutboxEvent)
            .where(
                OutboxEvent.status == "dispatching",
                OutboxEvent.attempt_count >= settings.outbox_max_attempts,
                or_(
                    OutboxEvent.locked_at.is_(None),
                    OutboxEvent.locked_at < stale_before,
                ),
            )
            .values(
                status="dead", locked_at=None, last_error_code="dispatch_lease_expired"
            )
        )
        expired_count = max(0, int(expired_result.rowcount or 0))
        if expired_count:
            record_pipeline_event(
                "outbox.dead",
                outcome="dead",
                stage="outbox",
                status="dead",
                value=expired_count,
            )
        statement = (
            select(OutboxEvent)
            .where(
                OutboxEvent.available_at <= now,
                or_(
                    OutboxEvent.status == "pending",
                    and_(
                        OutboxEvent.status == "dispatching",
                        or_(
                            OutboxEvent.locked_at.is_(None),
                            OutboxEvent.locked_at < stale_before,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                OutboxEvent.attempt_count < settings.outbox_max_attempts,
            )
            .order_by(OutboxEvent.created_at.asc())
            .limit(limit)
            .with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
        )
        rows = list((await session.scalars(statement)).all())
        for row in rows:
            row.status = "dispatching"
            row.locked_at = now
            row.attempt_count += 1
            row.last_error_code = None
        await session.commit()
        if rows:
            record_pipeline_event(
                "outbox.claimed",
                outcome="success",
                stage="outbox",
                status="dispatching",
                value=len(rows),
            )
            try:
                redis_client = get_rate_limit_redis_client()
                await redis_client.set(
                    "dispatcher:heartbeat", datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), ex=120
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        return [
            (
                str(row.id),
                row.tenant_id,
                row.event_type,
                dict(row.payload),
                row.attempt_count,
            )
            for row in rows
        ]
async def _mark_dispatched(event_id: str) -> None:
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        row = await session.get(OutboxEvent, uuid.UUID(event_id), with_for_update=True)
        if row is not None:
            row.status = "dispatched"
            row.dispatched_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            row.locked_at = None
            row.last_error_code = None
            await session.commit()
            record_pipeline_event(
                "outbox.dispatched",
                outcome="success",
                stage="outbox",
                status="dispatched",
            )
async def _mark_failed(event_id: str, attempt_count: int, exception_type: str) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    is_dead = attempt_count >= settings.outbox_max_attempts
    delay_seconds = min(2 ** min(attempt_count, 8), 300)
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        row = await session.get(OutboxEvent, uuid.UUID(event_id), with_for_update=True)
        if row is not None:
            row.status = "dead" if is_dead else "pending"
            row.locked_at = None
            row.available_at = now + timedelta(seconds=delay_seconds)
            row.last_error_code = f"dispatch_{exception_type[:64]}"
            await session.commit()
            record_pipeline_event(
                "outbox.dead" if is_dead else "outbox.failed",
                outcome="dead" if is_dead else "failure",
                stage="outbox",
                error_type=exception_type[:64],
                status=row.status,
            )
    logger.error(
        "outbox dispatch failed event_id=%s attempt=%s terminal=%s error_type=%s",
        event_id,
        attempt_count,
        is_dead,
        exception_type,
    )
async def _dispatch_once_inner() -> dict[str, int]:
    settings = get_settings()
    batch = await _claim_batch(settings.outbox_batch_size)
    dispatched = 0
    failed = 0
    for event_id, tenant_id, event_type, payload, attempt_count in batch:
        try:
            if event_type != "screening.requested":
                raise ValueError("unsupported_event_type")
            screening_id = str(uuid.UUID(str(payload["screening_id"])))
            enqueued_at = payload.get("enqueued_at")
            queued_at: datetime | None = None
            if isinstance(enqueued_at, str):
                try:
                    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(enqueued_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                    queued_at = parsed if parsed.tzinfo is not None else None
                except ValueError:
                    queued_at = None
            headers = build_task_headers(
                payload, tenant_id=tenant_id, event_id=event_id
            )
            with traced_stage(
                "outbox.dispatch",
                screening_id=screening_id,
                context=extract_trace_context(payload),
            ):
                screen_candidate.apply_async(
                    args=[screening_id], task_id=event_id, headers=headers
                )
            if queued_at is not None:
                record_outbox_dispatch_lag(
                    max(0.0, (datetime.now(UTC) - queued_at).total_seconds())
                )
            await _mark_dispatched(event_id)
            dispatched += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            await _mark_failed(event_id, attempt_count, type(exc).__name__)
            failed += 1
    if batch:
        logger.info(
            "outbox batch complete claimed=%s dispatched=%s failed=%s",
            len(batch),
            dispatched,
            failed,
        )
    return {"claimed": len(batch), "dispatched": dispatched, "failed": failed}
async def _dispatch_once() -> dict[str, int]:
    """Dispatch one batch under a parent span; per-event spans are created by the inner loop."""
    with traced_stage("outbox.batch"):
        return await _dispatch_once_inner()
@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.outbox.dispatch_pending_outbox", queue="outbox")
def dispatch_pending_outbox() -> dict[str, int]:
    """Dispatch one bounded outbox batch. Celery Beat schedules this task."""
    try:
        return _run_async(_dispatch_once)
    finally:
        try:
            from app.db.session import worker_engine
            worker_engine.sync_engine.dispose()
        except Exception:
            pass
````
